scripts.dev: concurrently -n demo,engine,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm dev:demo" "pnpm dev:engine" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dry-run/core build && pnpm --filter @dry-run/usher-rt build && pnpm --filter interface build
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter engine exec tsx src/eval/harness.ts --replay meridian-v1
scripts.db:push: pnpm --filter engine exec prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter engine exec prisma db seed
